attributes.title: 2027 AALNC Annual Forum
attributes.venue: Hyatt Regency San Francisco Downtown SOMA
attributes.cme_provider: American Association of Legal Nurse Consultants
attributes.organizer: American Association of Legal Nurse Consultants
attributes.summary:
The 2027 AALNC Annual Forum for legal nurse consultants takes place April 16 and 17, 2027, at the Hyatt Regency San Francisco Downtown SOMA, with a Pre-Forum day on April 15. AALNC says session details will be posted closer to the event.

AALNC is accredited by ANCC as a provider of nursing continuing professional development. Contact hours require attending each session in full and completing session and event evaluations; the total number of hours is not published yet.

Early-bird pricing runs through November 30: $950 for members and $1,235 for nonmembers (the nonmember rate includes membership). Standard rates are $995 and $1,280, the Pre-Forum costs $225, and registration closes March 22, 2027.
